model.name: drawer.singleTriggerActionBar
model.description: The action bar is driven by a SINGLE trigger path: the drawer dispatches rb-drawer-detail-shown{type,ref} from ANY source (its own render OR a box-select) and its own onDetailShown listener sets the action bar — so a box-select's {modelelement} signal reaches the bar (no orphaned signal, no double-fire). Distinct-intent from R33.6.5 drawer.selectionDrivenActions (which is the selection->verbs behaviour); this is the single-trigger WIRING that fixes the regression.
